svg.title: Workflow: Track Visitor
svg.desc: UML sequence diagram. A page event is rate-limited, scored and keyed at the gateway, then appended to Kafka; a batch consumer turns it into sessions and rollups exactly once in effect, and the read side serves cached aggregates with ETags. Messages: 1. POST /api/track; 2. 429 / 204, dropped; 3. geo-snap to city; 4. assess(token); 5. risk score; 6. eventId = UUIDv7; 7. produce raw event; 8. fallback: direct PostgreSQL insert; 9. 200 accepted; 10. poll batch ≤ 100; 11. dead-letter record; 12. SETNX eventId; 13. claim events in durable inbox; 14. upsert sessions + 5-min / daily rollups; 15. ack after commit; 16. GET /api/analytics/visits/summary; 17. GET /visits/summary; 18. 304 Not Modified; 19. read rollups; 20. 200 + weak ETag; 21. proxied response.
svg.text: A page event is rate-limited, scored and keyed at the gateway, then appended to Kafka; a batch consumer turns it into sessions and rollups exactly once in effect, and the read side
SETNX + inbox claim + ack-after-commit: redelivered batches never double-count
Result: City-level event counted once in sessions and rollups, served through a cached read model
